_comment: a471 display rule: view -> show | fold. No hide: a kind may be folded to one openable line, never removed (Owner 2026-11-20 21:0x JST); any value but fold is read as show. Default table = Tronie's, for the Owner's first live try; tune with the Owner. fold_group maps a view to the group its folded rows share (clients merge a run of one group into one line). From a folded tool_use on, every folded row up to the next shown row or the turn result is in the group fold_group.tool_use (a tool run, with fold_count 1 on the tool_use and 0 on the rest). Read at projection time only: stored events never change.
